A '''crown''' was an item worn on the head to signify that an individual was a [[King/Legends|king]] or queen. Cultures that used crowns included the [[Velmorian]]s,<ref name="Star Wars 1977 49">[[Star Wars (1977) 49|''Star Wars'' (1977) 49]]</ref> [[Quork/Legends|Quorks]],<ref name="Ewoks 1985 3">[[Ewoks (1985) 3|''Ewoks'' (1985) 3]]</ref> [[Titterbug]]s and [[Mudgub]]s,<ref name="Princess Latara">{{Ewoks|Princess Latara}}</ref> [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanians]],<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> and [[Squib/Legends|Squibs]].<ref name="Hnn-Squibs Announce They're Going Nowhere.">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|regional/13314_2.html|Squibs Announce They're "Going Nowhere."}}</ref>
